page.layout: One column of a printed table of contents, full width, with page numbers at the right end of each entry. Above it: the continuing entries of the previous exercise (Cap. 2 to Cap. 4). Below: a centred heading "EXERCIT. III." with its title, then the entries for Cap. 1 to Cap. 4, then the centred word FINIS at the foot. No running head, page number or signature is printed.

main_text.l: Cap. 2. Quod unusquisque tenetur credere, id est verum &c. solvitur. Item de fide a reprobis flagitata promissis euangelicis. Item Deum sine suo excidere non posse, contra Arminianos contenditur. 238
Cap. 3. An Dei beneplacitum sit prima regula justitiae, & bonitatis, & misericordiae ipsius erga Creaturas, contra Tho: Lack-sonum Anglum, & Iacobum Arminium. 287
Cap. 4. De voluntate Dei antecedente & consequente. 323
main_text.head: EXERCIT. III. De actibus Dei temporariis in libertatem humanam.
main_text.l: Cap. 1. An liberum arbitrium determinetur a Deo, an moraliter, an ad modum influxus Physici, in actibus tum naturae tum gratiae. 363
Cap. 2. De efficacia gratiae, contra Iesuitas & Arminianos. 395
Cap. 3. Iesuitarum & Arminianorum argumentis, contra gratiae efficaciam praedeterminatricem, occurritur. 477
Cap. 4. Monstrosa, vocationis congruae, fabula contra Suarezium, P. Fonsecam & Bellarm. rejicitur. 502

page.notes: The "&" sign is the printed ampersand form used for "et". Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout (e.g. "sine", "posse", "Monstrosa"). The name "Lack-sonum" is read from "Lackfonum" with long s; the hyphen is the printed line-end hyphen. Page numbers in the entries are printed at the right end of each line: 238, 287, 323, 363, 395, 477, 502.
